name: Bureau of Reclamation RISE API
update_frequency: Ongoing water and geospatial data updates
known_limitations: RISE provides Reclamation water and water-related data, but project-level water-availability claims require the selected site, parameter, date range, legal allocation context, and local provider evidence.
automation_notes: Use for bounded time-series and geospatial water evidence in western local-system dossiers.
